title: forge.CI reads a head whose every check run is SKIPPED as green, and admitted 6in's close-out over a red go job
body: GitHub.CI starts at CIGreen and treats skipped as neither pass nor fail, so a head carrying only skipped check runs is green. ci.yml skips every pull_request job on epic PRs by design and paths-ignores .ticfac/ on push, so every run-state head of an epic PR is all-skipped: the admission read green at seq 64, two seconds after recording red, and ciForTree never walked back to the code commit (its walk only runs on CINone). An all-skipped (or skipped/neutral-only) set must read as no verdict so the walk finds the code commit's push run; the close gate after the close-out has the same exposure.
demonstrating_check: go test ./internal/forge/ (a new case: every latest check run completed/skipped must not classify as CIGreen)
